# dsh-prompt-picker
English | 中文
One bolt icon ⚡ in the composer toolbar: click it and check the system prompts to inject. Multi-sele
bolt icon ⚡ in the composer toolbar: click it and check the system prompts to inject. Multi-select.
| Off (hollow) | On (solid) |
## What it does
- **Check = inject**: checked rows go into the system prompt in list order, separated by blank lines

; check nothing and nothing is injected
- **Per-row scope**: all / main agent only / sub-agents only

(click the chip at the end of a row; teammate sessions count as sub-agents)
- **New/Edit**: the foo
ter button expands straight into New prompt / Edit prompt (the latter lists every row and opens the

shared dialog); the dialog saves or deletes that row
- **Clear all**: unchecks every row at once (no

thing is deleted)
- **Every row deletable**, the built-in one included; an emptied list keeps one bl

ank row and the menu keeps its shape
- **Survives restarts**: state lives in `~/.dsh/prompt-picker.j

son`
- **Local debug log**: each injection appends one slim JSON line (scope verdict + names) to `~/
.dsh/prompt-picker-debug.log`; add `debugContext: true` to the row config for the full context dump.
Local only, auto-resets past 256 KiB
## Install

- **Market**: search `dsh-prompt-picker` in the DSH plugin market (dshmarket), one click
- **Manual*

*: Plugins page → Add plugin → paste `https://github.com/solopole/dsh-prompt-picker`
- **CLI**: `dsh
plugin --profile <name> add dsh-prompt-picker`
